description: Generate a task-aware local context packet with primary files, related files, tests, and validation commands. Deterministic by default; online:true also asks a read model for the request's intent and which candidate files it needs, reported under modelRead.

includeEvidence.description: Include per-file imports, exports, and symbol slices as source evidence. Defaults to false to keep the packet compact.

includeMarkdown.description: Return a compact human-readable markdown report instead of the full JSON packet. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum primary, related, and test files per section. Defaults to 8.

online.description: Ask a read model (TypeSafe's Jev or Claude) for the request's intent and each candidate file's relevance, applying confident answers. Needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; without either the pack is unchanged. Defaults to false.

path.description: Repository path. Defaults to current working directory.

paths.description: Repository paths for a multi-repo context packet. Omitted, `path` plus the `companions` listed in its .solumberc.json.

query.description: Task or question to gather context for.

name: context_pack
title: Context Pack
